Your Medical Journey

Online Consultation

Contact us and tell us what you are interested in – we advise you and refer you to the right specialist in Türkiye for an online consultation. Medical documents go directly to the doctor, only on request.

Advanced Medical Care and Travel Services

Find quick answers regarding our medical treatments, travel packages, and multilingual support services.

We offer dental treatments, hair transplantation, plastic surgery, and bariatric surgery through our partners.

Yes, we arrange flight and hotel services, airport transfers, and customized holiday packages.

For clinic treatments you stay at the five-star Dedeman Kozyatağı hotel in Istanbul. Your treatment package includes accommodation for you and one companion, with breakfast. For hospital treatments, accommodation is not included: you choose your hotel yourself, and on request we suggest hotels of different categories close to your hospital.

All transfers during your treatment – from the airport to your hotel, to the clinic or hospital and back – are made in a VIP vehicle.

No. MedLuxLife does not take any advance payment or deposit for treatments. You pay the full cost of your treatment directly at the clinic or hospital where you are treated.

Yes. The medical side and the organisation are kept clearly separate. All examinations and treatments are carried out exclusively by doctors and specialist teams at our partner clinics and hospitals, and they alone make every medical decision. MedLuxLife does not treat patients; our job is the coordination around your treatment: preparing your enquiry, arranging appointments, interpreters, transfers and accommodation, and staying in touch with you before, during and after your stay. For you, this means one contact person for the whole journey, while your treatment stays in the hands of medical specialists.
